info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Certification Management API
info.description: The Employee Certification Management API streamlines the process of managing employee certifications within an organization. This API allows users to efficiently submit and register new certifications, ensuring that all employee qualifications are correctly documented. Typical consumers include HR professionals and compliance officers who need to maintain up-to-date certification records for their workforce. With this API, organizations can enhance their human resource management and ensure compliance with industry standards.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new employee certification record in the human resource management system. It is essential for maintaining accurate employee certification details.
